{{Quote|Harrower dreadnaughts modified to carry state-of-the-art megalaser main cannons. They can destroy enemy capital ships in a single shot.|[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Valion Pyron|Pyron]]|<ref name="TOR:OM">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Imperial|Objective Meridian|the Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref>}}
The '''Silencer''' was a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] consisting of a rapidly recharging megalaser that could be mounted on a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. This laser was called a "fleet killer" because it had both the power and the speed of fire to destroy several capital ships in rapid succession. Because of this, it was considered a superweapon by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Description==
[[File:Silencertest.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The megalaser of the Silencer project]]
The Silencer was built upon the frame of a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]].
The middle trough down the center of the ship, usually used as the main corridor for entry and exit of ships on the dual hangar bays, was adapted to make way for the Megalaser mechanism. Both hangars installations were removed, and the Megalaser apparatus was installed in the middle of the ship.

The sides of the gap upon which the Megalaser fired were modified to withstand it and direct its path. Upon firing of the Megalaser burst, the trough had a residual electrical field visible down its length for a short time.<ref name="TOR10" />

==History==
[[File:Silencer.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Silencer]]
Using the [[Sun Razer]], the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] was able to complete its creation in [[Standard year/Legends|years]] instead of decades. All the projects fueled by the Sun Razer were overseen by [[Darth Mekhis]] and discovered by [[Theron Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]] upon their infiltration and capture in the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]]. Fearing the possibility that the Republic might soon arrive with reinforcements, Mekhis ordered the ships with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] to leave the system.<ref name="TOR10" />

By [[3641 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Darth Thanaton]] canceled the Silencer project, as he was a staunch believer in the superiority of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] over any new technology. However, Moff [[Valion Pyron]] contacted Thanaton's rival, Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], about the Silencer and stated that using it could win valuable allies within the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. The last piece required was a [[CN-12 sensor chip|CN-12]] chip being held by a group of [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] called the [[Veil]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

After acquiring the CN-12, Pyron managed to finish the Silencer megalaser and mounted it on the Imperial warship ''[[Doombringer]]''. Lord Kallig was then able to use the superweapon against a small Republic fleet, completely [[Testing of the Silencer|annihilating]] it. This had the effect of rallying Pyron and other Moffs to the Inquisitor's cause, which gave the rival Sith Lord the backing to seriously challenge Thanaton. Kallig also instructed Pyron to ensure that their allies got a Silencer for their own flagships.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Silencer_Fires.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Silencer megalaser fires.]]
As the [[Galactic War]] progressed, the Republic began to adapt both strategically and technologically against the Silencers in battle. Pyron's technicians proposed to increase the Silencers' radiation output at the cost of killing their own gunners, but Pyron deferred to Darth Nox for a decision.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>

When the [[Eternal Empire]] invaded the galaxy, most of the Silencers were lost in the initial fighting. The remaining equipped vessels disappeared in the Outer Rim and were believed to have been ambushed by the [[Eternal Fleet]], though no wreckage was found.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

During the [[third Galactic War]], the Silencers were deployed against the Republic once more, with many used during the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]].<ref name="TOR:OM" />
